prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Overhead still life of one slate grid frame with four square slots, each holding a thin six-sided hexagon tile in a different finish: ceramic, brushed steel, frosted glass and paper, with one further empty slot beside the frame, all inside the middle of the frame. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one small separate six-sided hexagon tile in amber glass resting beside the empty slot. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
